title: Phase 3: Launch & Convert - Execute social blitz and convert 3+ signups + 1 transaction
description:
Execute Phase 3 of revenue execution plan:

**Objective**: Get 3-10 producers signed up, aim for 1 paying customer (30min)

**Tasks**:
1. X/Twitter blitz (15min)
   - Post thread
   - Reply to beat-selling tweets
   - DM 10 micro-influencer producers (1k-10k followers)
   - Use hashtags: #beatmaking #musicproducer #beatsforsale

2. Reddit launch (10min)
   - Post to 3 subreddits (stagger by 5min)
   - Monitor comments, respond immediately
   - Offer promo codes: REDDIT100 (100% off first month)

3. Direct DMs to warm leads (20min)
   - Target: Producers you follow/engage with
   - Send 20 personalized DMs
   - Offer: Free onboarding call + setup assistance

4. Monitor & convert (15min)
   - Track signups in real-time
   - Reply to all questions <5min
   - Hand-hold first user through checkout
   - Offer $20 discount on first beat sale

**Success Metric**: 3+ signups, 1+ paying transaction

**Parent Plan**: [BRO-92](/BRO/issues/BRO-92#document-plan)
